svg.title: OmegaResearcher system architecture
svg.desc: Full architecture diagram showing Planner-Actor-Critic loop, MCP tools, memory system, ingestion, skills, subagent spawner, and meta-agent

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What kinds of inputs does OmegaResearcher accept?')
sendPrompt('Which file formats can be ingested?')
sendPrompt('How are CSV and Excel files handled?')
sendPrompt('How does the Orchestrator coordinate the PAC loop?')
sendPrompt('What does the PlannerAgent do and what skills does it use?')
sendPrompt('How does the ActorAgent decide what action to take next?')
sendPrompt('How does the CriticAgent score coverage?')
sendPrompt('How does Docling parse PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and HTML?')
sendPrompt('How does DataReader handle CSV and Excel files?')
sendPrompt('How does the web fetcher work with Playwright fallback?')
sendPrompt('How does INDEX-AS-YOU-GO work with IndexManager?')
sendPrompt('How does the rolling summary compression work?')
sendPrompt('What is the ScratchPad and how do subagents share it?')
sendPrompt('How does search_from_indexes find previously indexed content?')
sendPrompt('How does the Docker code executor sandbox work?')
sendPrompt('What MCP data tools are available?')
sendPrompt('How does on-demand SearxNG search differ from deep_search?')
sendPrompt('How does the file ingestion MCP tool work?')
sendPrompt('How does dynamic skill loading from SKILLS/ work?')
sendPrompt('How does create_skill generate a new SKILL.md file?')
sendPrompt('How does MetaLearn update skills from experiences?')
sendPrompt('How does SubagentSpawner spawn parallel sub-agents recursively?')
sendPrompt('What does a depth-1 sub-agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does a depth-2 sub-agent do?')
sendPrompt('Why does depth-3 stop spawning?')
sendPrompt('How does the Synthesizer build the final report from INDEXES/?')
sendPrompt('Why does the MetaAgent run in a separate LLM context?')
sendPrompt('What does the final research report look like?')
